summary: Waterstone Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized an additional 2,000,000 share repurchase under its existing program, increasing total availability to 2,148,285 shares (~11.9% of outstanding). No price, premium, or date specified. The open-market/block/private repurchases may occur under a Rule 10b5-1 plan; shares become authorized but unissued. Timing depends on market conditions and liquidity. Watch for buyback execution pace and potential EPS accretion.
